summary: Western Union filed an 8-K updating its pending acquisition of International Money Express (IMXI) under the August 10, 2025 merger agreement, with Merger Sub merging into IMXI, which survives as a wholly owned Western Union subsidiary. Most regulatory approvals are cleared, but California DFPI approval remains suspended and the HSR waiting period lapsed October 6, 2026. On October 2, 2026 both parties refiled Premerger Notification forms, starting a new 30-day HSR clock with early termination requested; DFPI reinstatement is not expected before October 6, 2026. Watch the California regulator and deal-timing risk.
